clips.title: The story
paras: Delgren the Purifier is a human paladin stationed at Maestra's Post on the northern edge of Ashenvale. Operating alongside comrades Balthule Shadowstrike and Feero Ironhand, he aids the night elves in cleansing demonic and shadow magic threatening the frontier, with a particular focus on the sinister Cult of the Dark Strand.

Human paladins are a rare sight deep within the ancient forests of Kalimdor, but Delgren the Purifier arrived with a mission. Affiliated with the Argent Dawn, Delgren traveled west with a cadre of holy warriors determined to assist the Alliance's new night elf allies against the lingering evils of demons and undead remnants from the Third War. Stationed near the border of Darkshore and Ashenvale, he maintains a watchful vigil over travelers passing south from Auberdine.
